changelog: Priority Rules: added explicit demotion signals for (a) boundaries that split a noun head from an immediate postnominal modifier/apposition within the next ~3 tokens, (b) boundaries immediately after a colon that introduces a clause completing or qualifying the prior assertion, and (c) candidates that are clustered within three source words of another candidate without intervening strong punctuation — these are ranking signals, not prohibitions.

Decision Procedure: instruct generating step to annotate candidates with surface features (distance to nearest candidate; whether a likely modifier/apposition begins within the next 3 tokens) and clarify that these annotations are used only during ranking to apply the demotion signals; emphasize not to remove candidates in generation.
